title: Engineering Compact Base Editors by AlphaFold-Guided Mutation Scan and Escherichia coli-Based Tri-Selection.
authors: Gang Son, Ryeo; Kim, Goeun; Lee, Jungjoon K
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold引导突变扫描和E. coli三选平台工程化紧凑型碱基编辑器，虽聚焦DNA脱氨酶与DNA底物互作，但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA结合口袋设计。
abstract: APOBEC1-based cytosine base editors such as BE4max enable base conversion, but many alternative deaminases show low activity and cytotoxicity, especially when miniaturized for delivery. SsdA(tox), a DNA deaminase toxin from Pseudomonas syringae that is two-thirds the size of APOBEC1, is attractive for compact base editors but, in native form, shows low C-to-T editing efficiency and high cytotoxicity. Guided by an AlphaFold- and CASTpFold-based alanine scan, we identified K31 as a gatekeeping residue whose substitution enlarges the modeled DNA binding pocket. Site-saturation mutagenesis at K31 produced variants with ten-fold higher activity but increased indel formation. To further enhance activity while reducing indels and cytotoxicity, we developed Trinity-Screen, an Escherichia coli (E. coli)-based three-in-one directed evolution platform that selects for high activity and reduced double-strand break-associated indels. Trinity-Screen revealed four additional DNA-binding positions; combinatorial mutagenesis at these sites generated four- and five-site SsdA(tox) variants that retained high activity yet showed lower indel rates and rescued bacterial viability. To standardize comparisons, we defined the Base Editor Performance Index (BEPI), which integrates C-to-T conversion and indel frequency. Optimized SsdA(tox) variants achieved up to 31-fold improvement relative to wild type, outperforming BE4max at multiple endogenous targets and displaying ten-fold lower cytotoxicity in E. coli.
abstract_zh: 基于APOBEC1的胞嘧啶碱基编辑器（如BE4max）能够实现碱基转换，但许多替代性脱氨酶活性低且具有细胞毒性，尤其是在小型化递送时。来自丁香假单胞菌（Pseudomonas syringae）的DNA脱氨酶毒素SsdA(tox)，其大小仅为APOBEC1的三分之二，对于紧凑型碱基编辑器具有吸引力，但在天然形式下，其C-to-T编辑效率低且细胞毒性高。通过基于AlphaFold和CASTpFold的丙氨酸扫描指导，我们鉴定出K31为门控残基，其替换可扩大模拟的DNA结合口袋。在K31位点进行饱和突变产生了活性提高十倍但插入缺失（indel）形成增加的变体。为进一步增强活性同时减少插入缺失和细胞毒性，我们开发了Trinity-Screen，一种基于大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli, E. coli）的三合一定向进化平台，该平台筛选高活性和减少双链断裂相关插入缺失的变体。Trinity-Screen揭示了四个额外的DNA结合位点；在这些位点的组合突变产生了四位点和五位点的SsdA(tox)变体，这些变体保持高活性，同时表现出较低的插入缺失率并恢复细菌活力。为标准化比较，我们定义了碱基编辑器性能指数（Base Editor Performance Index, BEPI），该指数整合了C-to-T转换和插入缺失频率。优化的SsdA(tox)变体相对于野生型实现了高达31倍的改进，在多个内源靶标上优于BE4max，并在大肠杆菌中显示出十倍低的细胞毒性。
